Colophon

How this site is made.

A personal site has a duty to declare its methods. This one does too.

  • Type

    Inter Tight for display and headings, Inter for body, JetBrains Mono for labels and code. Edit the imports in src/css/tokens.css to swap them.

  • Palette

    Cool neutral ink on near-white paper, with a single saturated indigo accent. Stored as OKLCH; see /styles/ for the full specimen.

  • Built with

    Node.js standard library only, no framework, no bundler, no dependencies. The whole build is in build.js.

  • Writing

    Markdown with a small set of MDX components (Dropcap, Pullquote, MarginaliaPin, Footnote). Files in src/content/.

  • Hosted on

    GitHub Pages, deployed by .github/workflows/pages.yml on every push to main.

  • Source

    Open source. PRs welcome.

For a live specimen of the palette, type, and components, see the design system ↗
